name: TWIST
notes: Included as an extra: a named collaboration with published final results at a fixed facility. The TWIST web page (twist.triumf.ca) timed out and was not used; the TRIUMF cyclotron is not recorded as an accelerator in the Atlas.

physics_goals.quote: A simultaneous measurement of the muon decay parameters {\rho}, {\delta}, and (P_{\mu}){\xi} tests the Standard Model (SM) in a purely leptonic process
physics_goals.value: Measure the muon decay parameters rho, delta and P_mu xi simultaneously to test the Standard Model in a purely leptonic process

summary.plain: An experiment at TRIUMF in Vancouver that measured how positrons are emitted when polarized muons decay, giving three parameters that test the Standard Model’s description of a purely leptonic process and limit models with a right-handed weak force.
summary.technical: TWIST at TRIUMF: highly polarized surface muons (M13 channel, 500 MeV protons on a graphite target) stopped in the detector located in the bore of a solenoid; simultaneous measurement of the muon decay parameters rho, delta and P_mu xi from the positron energy-angle spectrum; limits |(g_R/g_L) zeta| < 0.020 and (g_L/g_R) m_2 > 578 GeV/c^2 (90% C.L.).
